A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that

the McMurdo Group was produced by a combination of mantle partial melting and fractional crystallization, with the former process producing the basanites and basanitic andesites and the latter producing the nepheline-basalts.
fractional crystallization is the dominant process for the formation of the McMurDo Volcanics, and the trace-element data are consistent with the fractional crystallization models.
